messages.黒獣の味方に追加行動をさせる司令塔。S3で黒獣と3連撃を組み、守備で黒獣を入れ替: A commander that grants Heishou allies extra actions. S3 coordinates a three-hit sequence with Heishou allies, while defense swaps Heishou units and lets the incoming unit use S3 as well.
messages.S3の3連撃: 「黒獣たちよ、応えろ」の攻撃後、行動可能で畳み掛けが最も低い黒獣: **S3's three-hit sequence**: After Answer Me, Heishou Packs's attack, he issues Exalted Command to the Heishou ally who can act and has the lowest Unrelenting Storm, and that ally makes a one-sided attack on the same enemy with basic skill 3, once per turn. He then uses I Carve the Path of a Lord. If Exalted Command does not trigger, or the coordinating Heishou ally is staggered or dies, he uses Lonesome Stand: Sacrifice to Claim The Garden [孑孑單身, 捨生取园] instead.
messages.常時パッシブ「黒獣君主」: 自分以外の味方が待機解除・復帰すると精神力を回復させ: **Always-active passive — The Heishou Lord**: When an ally other than himself steps in from backup or returns, he restores their SP and has them make a one-sided attack with Skill 1 at Combat Start. For Heishou or Jia Family members, it restores 20 SP and the one-sided attack uses Skill 3 (2 times per battle per Identity).
messages.守備「黒獣利爪」で入れ替え: マッチ可能反撃。待機人員がいれば、体力比率が最も低: **Swapping with the Defense skill Heishou Keenclaw [黑獣利爪]**: A clashable counter. If there are units in backup, the 1 Heishou ally with the lowest HP ratio follows up with Skill 1 and retreats at Turn End (recovering 10% of max HP). If there are none in backup, that Heishou ally receives 2 Attack Power Up.
messages.全ての黒獣の主: ステージ開始時、待機人員を含めて編成した黒獣人格1名につき1得: **Leash-holder of All Heishou**: At stage start, he gains 1 for each Heishou Identity in the team, including backup. Raises Speed, Defense Level, and Offense Level, and at 5 or more, all Heishou Identities gain 1 Offense Level Up.
messages.バトルパッシブ「汚れた血さえも受け入れ、誰かの血に濡れながら意を果たす。」(暴食: **Combat passive — Embrace the Tarnished Blood and Exsanguinate Others For the Cause. (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Survives damage that would bring his HP to 0 at 1 HP for 1 turn and gains Tarnished Blood, once per battle. Tarnished Blood increases by 1 at Turn End, and he takes HP damage equal to 20% of max HP per point.
messages.黒獣人格を出撃と待機人員の両方に入れて組む。S3で黒獣との3連撃を組み、尊命の相: Build the team with Heishou Identities both deployed and in backup. Set up the three-hit sequence with Heishou allies through S3; the Exalted Command target is the Heishou ally who can act and has the lowest Unrelenting Storm, and on a tie, the Identity earlier in team order. Check which Heishou ally's S3 will come out before using it. When there are units in backup, use his Defense skill to retreat worn-out Heishou allies, and have the incoming Heishou ally fire S3 through The Heishou Lord. The Heishou Bolus Contamination [黑獣丸染] and Life from Death [死中求活] enhancements build slowly, so there is little need to aim for them. His durability is very low, so watch out for Clash losses.
